Players Committee card image of [[Larma D'Acy]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Finn and Poe are power +1 here. During your control phase, if with an opponent's spy, opponent loses 1 Force (2 if spy is Undercover). While Leia present at a battleground site, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/larma_d_acy.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/larma_d_acy.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
